lead.headline: Trump's Oval Office Push for Clarity Act Signals Regulatory Endgame, While CFTC Readies Fallback
lead.tldr: The White House is actively lobbying for crypto legislation, but the CFTC's parallel track on independent rulemaking means regulatory clarity is becoming a near-certainty regardless of Congressional gridlock—shifting investor focus from 'if' to 'who captures the architecture'.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, today the regulatory timeline compressed from 'eventually' to 'this Congress or the next agency action,' and that compression is already rerouting capital toward infrastructure plays that benefit from defined rules.

top_signals.title: Inside the Oval Office meeting: Trump appears ‘bullish’ on Clarity Act as he solicits feedback from crypto, finance CEOs
top_signals.summary: President Trump held a private Oval Office meeting with crypto and finance CEOs to solicit feedback on the Clarity Act. Sources indicate the President appears bullish on the passage of the legislation.

top_signals.title: CFTC chair says agency will move forward on crypto regulation if CLARITY fails
top_signals.summary: CFTC Chair Michael Selig stated that the agency will independently pursue crypto regulation if Congress fails to pass the CLARITY Act. This indicates a move toward regulatory certainty regardless of legislative outcomes.

top_signals.title: Kraken parent Payward explores becoming a 'full bank' outside the US
top_signals.summary: Payward, the parent company of Kraken, is exploring the possibility of obtaining a full banking license outside of the United States. The company aims to expand its service offerings to include lending, asset management, and potentially mortgages.

top_signals.title: Binance opens crypto trading to AI agents with user-set controls31m
top_signals.summary: Binance is introducing functionality that allows AI agents to execute crypto trades on behalf of users. The system includes user-defined controls to manage risk and permissions for these automated agents.

top_signals.title: Bitdeer signs $400M AI cloud computing deal for Malaysia facility
top_signals.summary: Bitdeer has secured a five-year AI cloud computing agreement for its facility in Malaysia. The deal is projected to generate approximately $400 million in total revenue for the company.

on_the_radar.title: Avalanche Is the Business Chain for Real-World Finance
on_the_radar.summary: Avalanche is positioning itself as a primary hub for real-world finance, seeing tokenized RWA value grow from $740M to over $3B. The network is attracting major institutional migrations and protocol deployments, including Aave V4 and Progmat.

on_the_radar.title: GnosisDAO approves Gnosis Chain for Ethereum Economic Zone
on_the_radar.summary: GnosisDAO has approved the transition of Gnosis Chain from a standalone layer-1 network to an Ethereum Economic Zone (EEZ) rollup. This move allows the chain to settle directly to Ethereum, enhancing its security and integration within the Ethereum ecosystem.

on_the_radar.title: Spot bitcoin ETFs report $517 million in net inflows, largest in 3.5 months
on_the_radar.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs experienced their largest net inflows in three and a half months, totaling $517 million. This surge is attributed to a broader crypto market rally following the US Treasury Department's announcement regarding buyback expansion.

on_the_radar.title: Bitcoin's rally pushes past $72,000 as analysts see demand beyond historic short squeeze
on_the_radar.summary: Bitcoin has rallied past the $72,000 mark, driven by a combination of a short squeeze and sustained demand from spot markets and ETFs. Analysts suggest that maintaining a price above $70,000 is critical to prove the rally's longevity.

on_the_radar.title: Bitcoin miners pour billions into AI as capex outpaces revenue 15-to-113m, Bitcoin miners pour billions into AI as capex outpaces revenue 15-to-1Nine public miners generated $341 million from AI and HPC operations in the first half of 2026 after spending more than $5 billion on capital assets.
on_the_radar.summary: Public Bitcoin miners are aggressively pivoting toward AI and High-Performance Computing (HPC), investing over $5 billion in capital assets. However, this transition shows a significant gap in immediate returns, with only $341 million generated in the first half of 2026.

on_the_radar.title: Optimism moves 546.9M OP from future airdrops to ecosystem growth fund7m, Optimism moves 546.9M OP from future airdrops to ecosystem growth fundThe governance vote redirects tokens previously reserved for user airdrops toward partnerships, incentives and Optimism’s growing institutional push.
on_the_radar.summary: Optimism has redirected 546.9 million OP tokens from a future airdrop allocation to its ecosystem growth fund. This move follows a governance vote aimed at prioritizing institutional growth, partnerships, and incentives over user airdrops.

on_the_radar.title: Cybersecurity firm unveils crypto phishing campaign targeting 885,000 phone numbers
on_the_radar.summary: Cybersecurity firm Rapid7 has identified a large-scale phishing campaign targeting nearly 900,000 phone numbers. The attackers are using fake websites to trick cryptocurrency investors into revealing their seed phrases.

on_the_radar.title: BitGo Korea secures VASP registration for institutional crypto custody
on_the_radar.summary: BitGo Korea has successfully obtained Virtual Asset Service Provider (VASP) registration in South Korea. This allows the company to provide institutional-grade crypto custody and transfer services amidst stricter regulatory requirements in the region.

worth_a_read.note: Delphi's case for Avalanche as the default settlement layer for tokenized real-world assets is worth engaging with given the regulatory clarity tailwinds building today.

worth_a_read.note: Galaxy's Beimnet Abebe on the dollar-Bitcoin inverse correlation offers a framework for repricing BTC's macro sensitivity as Treasury volatility shifts.

linkedin_post:
The President asked. The CFTC answered. Both want crypto rules done.

Trump's Oval Office session with crypto CEOs wasn't ceremonial. He wants the Clarity Act. But here's the move that matters for underwriting: CFTC Chair Selig already said his agency proceeds regardless. Legislative or administrative, the vector is the same. Regulatory certainty is no longer the risk. It's the baseline assumption.

That reprices everything. Kraken's parent Payward is hunting a full banking license outside the US. Not because America is hostile. Because defined rules abroad let you build products—lending, mortgages, asset management—that US ambiguity still traps in legal limbo. They're underwriting jurisdiction as product feature.

Binance's AI agent trading and Bitdeer's $400 million Malaysia compute deal share a thread. Infrastructure that works under clear rules gets capital. Infrastructure that waits for clarity doesn't.

We underwrite this sector on who can deploy into the architecture before the architecture finishes settling. The test: which firms locked in non-US banking partnerships, agent-trading integrations, or compute-offtake agreements before this week? Those are the positions that look mispriced if Clarity passes. Or if the CFTC simply fills the gap.

The gap is closing. The question is who already built across it.
